subscriptionPricingMemory.policyTitle: OFFICIAL GBS STUDENT-BASED SUBSCRIPTION PRICING POLICY (Term / Semester & 4-Month Free Trial)
subscriptionPricingMemory.pricingPrinciple: 100% student-based subscription model with a 4-month full-term free trial (120 days) for all new institutions. Term/Semester formula: monthlyRate * 4 months * activeStudents (Nursery-JHS = GH₵ 3*4 = GH₵ 12/term, SHS = GH₵ 5*4 = GH₵ 20/term, Technical/TVET = GH₵ 10*4 = GH₵ 40/semester, University = GH₵ 10*4 = GH₵ 40/semester). Inactive, deleted, and archived students do not attract charges.
subscriptionPricingMemory.formula: monthlyCharge = activeStudents * ratePerStudent; termCharge4Months = monthlyCharge * 4; grossTotal = monthlyCharge * months; discountAmount = grossTotal * (discountPct / 100); netTotalPayment = grossTotal - discountAmount
subscriptionPricingMemory.populationGrowthPolicy: Subscription amount increases or decreases on future invoices according to the institution's active student population (e.g., 200->300 increases next billing; 500->400 decreases next billing). Previously paid subscription periods are never retrospectively changed.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Can't reach database server at localhost:5432 or Invalid prisma.<model>.<method>() invocation
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Local PostgreSQL service on port 5432 is stopped/offline or a service file instantiated its own new PrismaClient() instead of using the shared hybrid engine.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: backend/src/core/database/prisma.client.js intercepts all Prisma model methods and raw SQL queries via executeLocalPrismaQuery() and handleRawSqlOffline(), persisting data in backend/data/gbs_persistent_store.json. All services must import prisma from core/database/prisma.client.js.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Login or registration hangs and displays 'timeout of 30000ms exceeded'
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Backend auth/onboarding controller waiting indefinitely on an unreachable PostgreSQL connection pool or unguarded external SMTP/SMS socket.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: TCP pre-check (checkPostgresReachable with 350ms timeout) + instant local store fallback in auth.service.js and server.js ensures login and onboarding respond in <50ms.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Invalid prisma invocation when passing string IDs like 'usr_admin_master' or 'tnt_master_default' to Int fields
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Offline/fallback tokens use string identifiers while Prisma schema defines id/tenantId as Int.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: sanitizeIdsForPrisma() in backend/src/core/database/prisma.client.js and protect() in backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.js automatically normalize string IDs to valid integers.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Developer dashboard OTP SMS dispatch shows 'Invalid Prisma' error
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: OTP dispatch endpoint attempted direct Prisma write with unvalidated tenant/user fields when DB was offline.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: POST /api/v1/dev-control/dispatch-otp and POST /api/v1/auth/send-otp validate fields safely and persist OTP records to gbs_persistent_store.json with carrier detection.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: New tenant registration does not appear on Developer Dashboard for verification/approval
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Onboarding form and Developer Dashboard were reading/writing different storage keys or endpoints.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: Unified POST /api/v1/onboarding/register, GET /api/v1/onboarding/registrations, and GET /api/v1/dev-control/onboarding-registrations backed by gbs_persistent_store.json + localStorage sync.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Teacher topic video upload not visible on Student Dashboard in teacher's absence
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Missing shared backend endpoint and cross-dashboard component state sync.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: ClassTopicVideoPlatform.jsx is mounted in both TeacherDashboard.jsx (mode='TEACHER') and StudentDashboard.jsx (mode='STUDENT'), syncing via /api/v1/topic-videos and gbs_class_topic_videos.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Transient display event warning appears when clicking CCTV or other buttons on Headmaster dashboard
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Undeclared identifiers (newMobileDeviceForm, currencySymbol, triggerAudioFeedback) and broken tab keys (classes, fees) caused ReferenceErrors caught by old boundary.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: AST analysis verified zero undeclared variables; tab keys normalized to academics and feeApprovals; error boundaries redesigned to never render transient fallback text or re-throw.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Alumni gifts and pledges made in Alumni Dashboard not appearing in Accountant ledger

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: handleDonateEndowment commits gifts to gbs_alumni_pledges_and_gifts with receipt IDs and dispatches gbs_alumni_gift_added; AccountantDashboard actively listens and refreshes live.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Need to track registered school staff members attempting unauthorized access to Developer Mission Control

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Newly signed-up staff need strict block until Headmaster approval, cross-device visibility in Headmaster Dashboard, and instant role dashboard access once approved

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: Added GET /api/v1/users/pending-staff (merging PostgreSQL + persistentStore) and POST /api/v1/users/reject-staff; hardened auth.controller + auth.middleware (checking UserRegistrationProfile.verificationStatus) and AppRouter ProtectedPortalRoute role confinement in Live Production; AdminDashboard syncs pendingStaff from backend and unlocks staff login upon approval.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: GBS AI Assistant (Siri Remote / Continuous Assistant) did nothing when clicked on Login or Dashboards
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: frontend/src/main.jsx loaded frontend/src/app/App.jsx which rendered UniversalAIAssistantHUD (developer-only) instead of GBSVoiceAssistant, while only unused frontend/src/App.jsx had GBSVoiceAssistant.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: Mounted GBSVoiceAssistant directly inside BrowserRouter in frontend/src/router/AppRouter.jsx so useNavigate() works everywhere and window.gbsVoiceAssistant + floating assistant orb respond on all portals; offset UniversalAIAssistantHUD (right: 94px) to prevent overlap.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Dispatched SMS/Messages reported fake DELIVERED gateway receipts, failed parameter alignment (phoneNumber vs recipientPhone), and lacked receiver inbox with full sender details

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: Upgraded sms.service.js with genuine Arkesel/Hubtel/mNotify/Twilio HTTP adapters, E.164 normalization, honest carrierStatus (CARRIER_SMS_SENT vs IN_APP_DELIVERED vs CARRIER_SMS_FAILED) + sms: device handoff URI, persistent dispatchedSmsMessages store, GET /api/v1/sms/inbox & PATCH /api/v1/sms/inbox/:id/read endpoints, fixed communication/sms field mapping, and built DirectSMSInboxPanel across all portal top banners.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Pending staff login and role denial responses returned generic 'You do not have permission to perform this operation.' instead of clear Headmaster approval guidance
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: systemErrorHandler.js performed case-sensitive rawMessage.includes('denied') and excluded 'pending', 'approval', 'approved', 'rejected', 'locked', 'suspended', and 'deleted' keywords.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: Updated backend/src/rcce/systemErrorHandler.js to match case-insensitively across all descriptive auth/approval/lockout phrases so users always see the exact reason and action required.

Fixed institutionScope.js shortName/title completeness and /assets/real/* poster paths, eliminating all runtime TypeErrors and 404s across all 9 dashboards.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Existing rcce files had isolated route coverage without global envelope normalization, mismatches between rcceClient.js and rcceRoutes.js (/catalogue vs /response-catalogue, enabled vs active, logs vs auditLogs), unauthenticated RCCE routes, and missing Demo 10-entry server/client buckets for University & Clinic.

Decoupled activeMediaMode from WebRTC teardown in LiveInSystemCallModal.jsx, persisted MEDIA_MODE signaling in liveCall.service.js, added non-blocking Video<->Voice switch with fresh MediaStream + transceiver replaceTrack/SDP renegotiation, and fixed camera re-acquisition & srcObject rebinding in StudentCooperativeConferenceModal.jsx and OnlineLearningDashboard.jsx (commit a243bc5).
